records.literal_gloss: For the director, for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: for Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. For Jeduthun. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : pour Jeduthun. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Pour Jeduthun. Psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Pour Jeduthun. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa Yeduthuni. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Kwa Yeduthuni. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: para Jedutún. Un salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Para Jedutún. Un salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para Jedutún. Un canto de David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: Jeduthun: a leader of the temple singers
decisions.reason: Jeduthun was one of the leaders of the music at the sanctuary in David's time (1 Chronicles 16:41; 25:1). His name also stands in the titles of Psalms 62 and 77.

decisions.choice: Jeduthun: the name as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew writes the name with a slightly different spelling and its notes say to read it as Jeduthun. The words follow the form to be read.

source.text: אָמַ֗רְתִּי אֶֽשְׁמְרָ֣ה דְרָכַי֮ מֵחֲט֪וֹא בִלְשׁ֫וֹנִ֥י אֶשְׁמְרָ֥ה לְפִ֥י מַחְס֑וֹם בְּעֹ֖ד רָשָׁ֣ע לְנֶגְדִּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: I said, I will guard my ways from sinning with my tongue; I will keep for my mouth a muzzle while [the] wicked [is] before me.

en.L: I said, "I will guard my ways from sinning with my tongue; I will keep a muzzle on my mouth while [the] wicked [is] in front of me."
en.B: I made up my mind: "I will be careful how I live, so that my tongue does not lead me into sin. I will keep my mouth muzzled for as long as the wicked stand before me."
en.R: I decided, "I will be careful not to sin by what I say. I will keep my mouth shut while wicked people are around me."

fr.L: J’ai dit : « Je garderai mes voies pour ne pas pécher par ma langue ; je garderai une muselière à ma bouche tant que [le] méchant [est] devant moi. »
fr.B: J’avais décidé : « Je veillerai sur ma conduite, pour que ma langue ne me fasse pas pécher. Je tiendrai ma bouche muselée tant que les méchants seront devant moi. »
fr.R: J’avais décidé : « Je ferai attention à ne pas pécher par mes paroles. Je garderai la bouche fermée tant que les méchants seront autour de moi. »

sw.L: Nilisema, "Nitazilinda njia zangu nisitende dhambi kwa ulimi wangu; nitakitia kinywa changu kizuizi wakati mwovu [yuko] mbele yangu."
sw.B: Niliamua moyoni: "Nitakuwa mwangalifu jinsi ninavyoishi, ili ulimi wangu usinitie dhambini. Nitakifunga kinywa changu kwa kizuizi muda wote waovu wakiwa wamesimama mbele yangu."
sw.R: Niliamua, "Nitakuwa mwangalifu nisitende dhambi kwa maneno yangu. Nitakifunga kinywa changu wakati watu waovu wako karibu nami."

es.L: Dije: «Guardaré mis caminos para no pecar con mi lengua; pondré bozal a mi boca mientras [el] malvado [esté] delante de mí».
es.B: Tomé una decisión: «Tendré cuidado de cómo vivo, para que mi lengua no me lleve a pecar. Mantendré mi boca con bozal mientras los malvados estén delante de mí».
es.R: Decidí: «Tendré cuidado de no pecar con lo que digo. Mantendré la boca cerrada mientras haya gente malvada a mi alrededor».

decisions.choice: I said: I resolved
decisions.reason: Here "I said" is a resolve made within, as often in the Psalms (30:7).

decisions.choice: muzzle: a muzzle or bridle
decisions.reason: The word (machsom) occurs only here; it is a muzzle such as is put on an animal.

decisions.choice: while the wicked is before me: why he keeps silent
decisions.reason: He holds back his complaint while the wicked can hear it, so as not to sin by speaking against God in front of them.

decisions.choice: the wicked ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew describes "the wicked" as one person ("he", "his") who stands for all who act this way. Balanced and Readable make the portrait plural, which is how "the wicked" is heard in English and includes men and women alike; Literal keeps the Hebrew singular.

source.text: נֶאֱלַ֣מְתִּי ד֭וּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁ֣יתִי מִטּ֑וֹב וּכְאֵבִ֥י נֶעְכָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: I was mute [with] silence; I held still from good, and my pain was stirred up.

en.L: I was mute in silence; I kept quiet [even] from good, and my pain was stirred up.
en.B: I said nothing at all; I held my peace, even from saying good, and my pain grew sharper.
en.R: So I kept completely quiet. I would not even speak good words. But that only made my pain worse.

fr.L: Je suis resté muet dans le silence ; je me suis tu [même] du bien, et ma douleur s’est réveillée.
fr.B: Je n’ai rien dit du tout ; je me suis tu, même pour dire du bien, et ma douleur est devenue plus vive.
fr.R: Alors je suis resté complètement silencieux. Je ne disais même pas de bonnes paroles. Mais cela n’a fait qu’augmenter ma douleur.

sw.L: Nilikuwa bubu kwa ukimya; nilinyamaza [hata] kuhusu mema, na maumivu yangu yakachochewa.
sw.B: Sikusema neno lolote; nilinyamaza, hata kusema mema, na maumivu yangu yakazidi.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilinyamaza kabisa. Sikusema hata maneno mema. Lakini hilo lilizidisha tu maumivu yangu.

es.L: Enmudecí en silencio; callé [aun] del bien, y mi dolor se agravó.
es.B: No dije absolutamente nada; guardé silencio, aun sin decir lo bueno, y mi dolor se hizo más agudo.
es.R: Así que me quedé completamente callado. Ni siquiera decía palabras buenas. Pero eso solo empeoró mi dolor.

decisions.choice: kept quiet from good: even from good words
alternatives: to no avail (it did no good)
decisions.reason: The phrase is short: "I kept silent from good". It may mean he held back even good words, or that his silence did no good.

decisions.choice: stirred up: grew worse
decisions.reason: The verb ('akar) is to stir up or trouble; holding in his grief made it worse.

decisions.choice: But that only
decisions.reason: Readable makes the link between the silence and the pain plain, as the meaning decision reads it (m2).

records.literal_gloss: My heart grew hot within me; in my sighing a fire burned; I spoke with my tongue.

en.L: My heart grew hot within me; in my musing a fire burned; I spoke with my tongue:
en.B: Inside me my heart was burning; as I brooded, it flared into fire, and at last I spoke:
en.R: I felt hot inside, as if a fire were burning. The more I thought about it, the worse it got. Finally I spoke up.

fr.L: Mon cœur s’est échauffé au-dedans de moi ; dans ma méditation un feu a brûlé ; j’ai parlé de ma langue :
fr.B: Au-dedans de moi mon cœur brûlait ; à force de ruminer, il s’est embrasé, et enfin j’ai parlé :
fr.R: Je me sentais brûlant à l’intérieur, comme si un feu y brûlait. Plus j’y pensais, plus c’était fort. Finalement, j’ai parlé.

sw.L: Moyo wangu ulipata moto ndani yangu; katika kutafakari kwangu moto uliwaka; nilisema kwa ulimi wangu:
sw.B: Ndani yangu moyo wangu ulikuwa ukiwaka; nilipokuwa nikiwaza, uliwaka moto, na mwishowe nikasema:
sw.R: Nilihisi joto ndani yangu, kana kwamba moto unawaka. Kadiri nilivyolifikiria, ndivyo lilivyozidi. Mwishowe nikasema.

es.L: Mi corazón se enardeció dentro de mí; en mi meditar ardió un fuego; hablé con mi lengua:
es.B: Por dentro me ardía el corazón; mientras daba vueltas a todo, se encendió en llamas, y al fin hablé:
es.R: Sentía calor por dentro, como si me quemara un fuego. Cuanto más lo pensaba, peor se ponía. Al final hablé.

decisions.choice: musing: sighing, brooding
decisions.reason: The word (hagig) is rare: a murmuring or sighing, inward thought that is almost spoken (Psalm 5:2).

decisions.choice: my heart grew hot, a fire burned: feeling that could not be held in
decisions.reason: Held-in grief is pictured as a fire that must break out, as with Jeremiah (Jeremiah 20:9).

decisions.choice: a colon before the prayer
decisions.reason: The sentence leads into the words he spoke, which are the prayer of verses 5-14; a colon shows that, without quotation marks around the whole prayer.

source.text: הוֹדִ֘יעֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀קִצִּ֗י וּמִדַּ֣ת יָמַ֣י מַה־הִ֑יא אֵ֝דְעָ֗ה מֶה־חָדֵ֥ל אָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Make known to me, YHWH, my end and the measure of my days, what it [is]; let me know how fleeting I [am].

en.L: Make known to me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, my end, and the measure of my days, what it [is]; let me know how fleeting I [am].
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, let me know my end and how many days are measured out for me; let me understand how short-lived I am.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show me when my life will end. Show me how many days I have. Help me understand how short my life is.

fr.L: Fais-moi connaître, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ma fin, et la mesure de mes jours, ce qu’elle [est] ; que je sache combien je [suis] passager.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-moi connaître ma fin et le nombre de jours qui me sont comptés ; fais-moi comprendre combien ma vie est brève.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, montre-moi quand ma vie finira. Montre-moi combien de jours il me reste. Aide-moi à comprendre que ma vie est courte.

sw.L: Unijulishe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mwisho wangu, na kipimo cha siku zangu, ni kipi; nijue jinsi nilivyo wa kupita.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unijulishe mwisho wangu na idadi ya siku nilizopimiwa; nielewe jinsi maisha yangu yalivyo mafupi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unionyeshe maisha yangu yatakapokwisha. Unionyeshe nina siku ngapi. Unisaidie kuelewa jinsi maisha yangu yalivyo mafupi.

es.L: Hazme saber, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, mi fin, y la medida de mis días, cuál [es]; sepa yo cuán pasajero [soy].
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, hazme conocer mi fin y cuántos días se me han medido; hazme entender lo breve que es mi vida.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstrame cuándo terminará mi vida. Muéstrame cuántos días tengo. Ayúdame a entender lo corta que es mi vida.

decisions.choice: my end, the measure of my days: to grasp how brief life is
alternatives: to learn the date of his death
decisions.reason: The prayer is not for a date but for a true sense of how short life is (Psalm 90:12).

decisions.choice: fleeting: ceasing, soon over
decisions.reason: The word (chadel) describes what stops or comes to an end.

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה טְפָח֨וֹת׀נָ֘תַ֤תָּה יָמַ֗י וְחֶלְדִּ֣י כְאַ֣יִן נֶגְדֶּ֑ךָ אַ֥ךְ כָּֽל־הֶ֥בֶל כָּל־אָ֝דָ֗ם נִצָּ֥ב סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, handbreadths you have made my days, and my lifespan [is] like nothing before you; surely all vanity [is] every human standing. Selah.

en.L: Look, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made my days handbreadths, and my lifetime [is] as nothing before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; surely every human, [though] standing firm, [is] all breath. Selah
en.B: See, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made my days only a few hand widths long; my whole lifetime is as nothing in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight. Every human being, however firmly they stand, is only a breath. Selah
en.R: You have made my life very short, only as wide as a hand. My whole life is nothing compared to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Every person is like a breath of air. Selah

fr.L: Voici, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait mes jours [larges] de quelques paumes, et ma durée [est] comme rien devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; oui, tout être humain, [même] debout ferme, [n’est] que souffle. Sélah
fr.B: Vois, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait mes jours longs de quelques largeurs de main ; toute ma vie n’est rien à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux. Tout être humain, si ferme qu’il se tienne, n’est qu’un souffle. Sélah
fr.R: Tu as rendu ma vie très courte, pas plus large qu’une main. Toute ma vie n’est rien à côté de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Chaque personne est comme un souffle d’air. Sélah

sw.L: Tazama, umezifanya siku zangu kuwa upana wa viganja, na umri wangu [ni] kama si kitu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; hakika kila mwanadamu, [ingawa] amesimama imara, [ni] pumzi tu. Sela
sw.B: Tazama, umezifanya siku zangu kuwa na urefu wa viganja vichache tu; maisha yangu yote ni kama si kitu machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}. Kila mwanadamu, hata akisimama imara namna gani, ni pumzi tu. Sela
sw.R: Umeyafanya maisha yangu kuwa mafupi sana, kama upana wa kiganja tu. Maisha yangu yote si kitu ukilinganisha {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. Kila mtu ni kama pumzi ya hewa. Sela

es.L: He aquí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho mis días [como] palmos, y mi vida [es] como nada delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; ciertamente todo ser humano, [aunque] esté firme, [es] solo un soplo. Selah
es.B: Mira, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho mis días de apenas unos palmos; toda mi vida es como nada ante {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos. Todo ser humano, por firme que esté, es solo un soplo. Selah
es.R: Tú has hecho mi vida muy corta, solo del ancho de una mano. Toda mi vida no es nada comparada contigo. Cada persona es como un soplo de aire. Selah

decisions.choice: handbreadths: the smallest measure
decisions.reason: A handbreadth (tefach) is the width of four fingers, one of the smallest measures in daily use (Exodus 25:25).

decisions.choice: breath: vapor, what passes at once
decisions.reason: The word (hevel) is a breath or vapor, the word of Ecclesiastes 1:2. It returns in verses 7 and 12.

decisions.choice: standing: even at their firmest
decisions.reason: The word (nitsav) means standing firm; even a person who seems secure is only breath.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "upana wa viganja" (the width of palms) for handbreadths, with no measures setting
decisions.reason: The point is not a measure but how little a hand's width is, so Swahili names the palm of the hand, the smallest width anyone knows; the English likewise has no measures setting here.

source.text: אַךְ־בְּצֶ֤לֶם׀יִֽתְהַלֶּךְ־אִ֗ישׁ אַךְ־הֶ֥בֶל יֶהֱמָי֑וּן יִ֝צְבֹּ֗ר וְֽלֹא־יֵדַ֥ע מִי־אֹסְפָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely as a shadow a man walks about; surely [in] vain they are in turmoil; he heaps up and does not know who will gather them.

en.L: Surely as a shadow {{gender:a person|a man}} walks about; surely for nothing they bustle about; {{gender:they heap|he heaps}} up [wealth] and {{gender:do|does}} not know who will gather it.
en.B: Truly, people go about like shadows; their busy noise is all for nothing; they pile things up, not knowing who will collect them.
en.R: People are like shadows moving around. They rush around for nothing. They store up riches, but they do not know who will get them.

fr.L: Oui, comme une ombre {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} va et vient ; oui, pour rien ils s’agitent ; il amasse [des richesses] et ne sait pas qui les recueillera.
fr.B: Vraiment, les gens passent comme des ombres ; toute leur agitation ne sert à rien ; ils entassent, sans savoir qui ramassera.
fr.R: Les gens sont comme des ombres qui bougent. Ils courent partout pour rien. Ils mettent des richesses de côté, mais ils ne savent pas qui les aura.

sw.L: Hakika kama kivuli mtu hutembea; hakika bure wanahangaika; hulimbikiza [mali] wala hajui ni nani atakayeikusanya.
sw.B: Kweli, watu hutembea kama vivuli; makelele yao ya shughuli ni bure tu; hurundika vitu, bila kujua ni nani atakayevikusanya.
sw.R: Watu ni kama vivuli vinavyozunguka. Wanahangaika bure. Wanajiwekea mali, lakini hawajui ni nani atakayeipata.

es.L: Ciertamente como una sombra anda {{gender:la persona|el hombre}}; ciertamente en vano se afanan; amontona [riquezas] y no sabe quién las recogerá.
es.B: De verdad, la gente anda como sombras; todo su ajetreo es para nada; amontonan cosas sin saber quién se quedará con ellas.
es.R: La gente es como sombras que se mueven de un lado a otro. Corren de aquí para allá para nada. Guardan riquezas, pero no saben quién se quedará con ellas.

decisions.choice: a shadow: an image without substance
decisions.reason: The word (tselem) is an image or likeness; here it is a mere outline, like a shadow (Psalm 73:20).

decisions.choice: heaps up: wealth, though the object is not named
decisions.reason: The verb (tsavar) is to pile up, used of grain and silver (Genesis 41:35; Job 27:16); others will gather what he has stored (Luke 12:20).

decisions.choice: inclusive wording by default; the traditional "he" or "man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a masculine singular for a person who stands for anyone of this kind, so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default and the traditional form as the alternative.

decisions.choice: a person ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is masculine but stands for anyone who lives this way. Balanced and Readable speak of people in general, which needs no setting; Literal keeps the singular with the gender setting.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֣ה מַה־קִּוִּ֣יתִי אֲדֹנָ֑י תּ֝וֹחַלְתִּ֗י לְךָ֣ הִֽיא׃

records.literal_gloss: And now what do I wait for, Lord? My hope, it [is] in you.

en.L: And now, what do I wait for, Lord? My hope, it [is] in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: So then, Lord, what is left for me to wait for? My hope rests on {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: So, Lord, what can I look forward to? I put my hope in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Et maintenant, qu’est-ce que j’attends, Seigneur ? Mon espérance, elle [est] en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Alors, Seigneur, que me reste-t-il à attendre ? Mon espérance repose sur {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Alors, Seigneur, qu’est-ce que je peux attendre ? Je mets mon espoir en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Na sasa, ninangojea nini, Bwana? Tumaini langu, [liko] {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: Basi, Bwana, ni nini kilichobaki cha kungojea? Tumaini langu limekaa {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo, Bwana, ninaweza kutazamia nini? Ninaweka tumaini langu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

es.L: Y ahora, ¿qué espero, Señor? Mi esperanza, ella [está] en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Entonces, Señor, ¿qué me queda por esperar? Mi esperanza descansa en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.R: Entonces, Señor, ¿qué puedo esperar? Pongo mi esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

decisions.choice: And now: the turn of the psalm
decisions.reason: From the shortness of life the psalmist turns to God: if life is a breath, hope can rest only in him.

decisions.choice: Lord: the title 'Adonai
decisions.reason: As in 38:10.

records.literal_gloss: From all my transgressions deliver me; [the] reproach of [the] fool do not make me.

en.L: From all my transgressions deliver me; do not make me the reproach of [the] fool.
en.B: Rescue me from all my rebellious acts; do not make me something fools laugh at.
en.R: Save me from all the wrong things I have done. Do not let foolish people make fun of me.

fr.L: De toutes mes transgressions délivre-moi ; ne fais pas de moi l’opprobre de l’insensé.
fr.B: Délivre-moi de toutes mes révoltes ; ne fais pas de moi la risée des insensés.
fr.R: Sauve-moi de tout le mal que j’ai fait. Ne laisse pas les insensés se moquer de moi.

sw.L: Kutoka katika makosa yangu yote uniokoe; usinifanye aibu ya mpumbavu.
sw.B: Uniokoe kutoka katika matendo yangu yote ya uasi; usinifanye kitu cha kuchekwa na wapumbavu.
sw.R: Uniokoe kutoka katika mabaya yote niliyoyatenda. Usiwaache wapumbavu wanidhihaki.

es.L: De todas mis transgresiones líbrame; no me hagas la burla del necio.
es.B: Rescátame de todos mis actos de rebelión; no me conviertas en algo de lo que se rían los necios.
es.R: Sálvame de todas las cosas malas que he hecho. No dejes que la gente necia se burle de mí.

decisions.choice: the fool: one who scorns God
decisions.reason: The fool (naval) in the Psalms is not slow-witted but one who lives as if there were no God (Psalm 14:1).

decisions.choice: transgressions: acts of rebellion
decisions.reason: The word (pesha') is rebellion, a breach of loyalty.

source.text: נֶ֭אֱלַמְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶפְתַּח־פִּ֑י כִּ֖י אַתָּ֣ה עָשִֽׂיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for you have done [it].

en.L: I am mute; I do not open my mouth, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done [it].
en.B: I stay silent and say nothing, because this is {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} doing.
en.R: I am quiet. I do not say anything, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who did this.

fr.L: Je suis muet ; je n’ouvre pas la bouche, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui [l’]as fait.
fr.B: Je reste silencieux et ne dis rien, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as agi.
fr.R: Je me tais. Je ne dis rien, parce que c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui as fait cela.

sw.L: Nimekuwa bubu; sifumbui kinywa changu, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umefanya [hivi].
sw.B: Ninakaa kimya wala sisemi kitu, kwa sababu jambo hili ni kazi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ninanyamaza. Sisemi chochote, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye uliyefanya hivi.

es.L: Enmudecí; no abro mi boca, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [lo] has hecho.
es.B: Me quedo en silencio y no digo nada, porque esto es obra {{deity_pronoun:tuya|Tuya}}.
es.R: Estoy callado. No digo nada, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el que hizo esto.

decisions.choice: you have done it: the suffering is from God's hand
decisions.reason: His silence now is different from verse 3: he accepts that his suffering comes from God, and speaks only to God.

source.text: הָסֵ֣ר מֵעָלַ֣י נִגְעֶ֑ךָ מִתִּגְרַ֥ת יָ֝דְךָ֗ אֲנִ֣י כָלִֽיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Remove from upon me your stroke; from the hostility of your hand I am finished.

en.L: Remove {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} blow from upon me; by the hostility of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand I am worn out.
en.B: Take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} blow away from me; I am worn out by the force of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand.
en.R: Please stop punishing me. The force of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand has worn me out.

fr.L: Écarte de dessus moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} coup ; sous l’hostilité de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main je suis épuisé.
fr.B: Éloigne de moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} coups ; je suis à bout sous la force de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main.
fr.R: S’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, arrête de me punir. La force de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main m’a épuisé.

sw.L: Uniondolee pigo {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}; kwa uadui wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} nimechoka kabisa.
sw.B: Uliondoe pigo {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} juu yangu; nimechoshwa na nguvu za mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Tafadhali acha kuniadhibu. Nguvu za mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} zimenichosha.

es.L: Quita de sobre mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} golpe; por la hostilidad de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano estoy consumido.
es.B: Aparta de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} golpe; estoy agotado por la fuerza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano.
es.R: Por favor, deja de castigarme. La fuerza de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano me ha dejado agotado.

decisions.choice: blow: a stroke, a plague
decisions.reason: As in 38:12.

decisions.choice: hostility: attack, strife
decisions.reason: The word (tigrah) occurs only here; it comes from a verb meaning to stir up strife.

source.text: בְּֽתוֹכָ֘ח֤וֹת עַל־עָוֺ֨ן׀יִסַּ֬רְתָּ אִ֗ישׁ וַתֶּ֣מֶס כָּעָ֣שׁ חֲמוּד֑וֹ אַ֤ךְ הֶ֖בֶל כָּל־אָדָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: With rebukes for iniquity you discipline a man, and you melt like the moth his treasure; surely vanity [is] all humankind. Selah.

en.L: With rebukes for iniquity {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} discipline {{gender:a person|a man}}, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} consume like the moth what {{gender:they hold|he holds}} dear; surely every human [is] a breath. Selah
en.B: You punish people for their wrongs with rebukes, and like a moth {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} eat away what they love most. Every human being is only a breath. Selah
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} correct people for their sin, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} destroy what they love, the way a moth eats cloth. Every person is like a breath of air. Selah

fr.L: Par des reproches pour la faute {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corriges {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}}, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} consumes comme la teigne ce qu’il a de précieux ; oui, tout être humain [n’est qu’]un souffle. Sélah
fr.B: Tu punis les gens de leurs fautes par {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} reproches, et comme la teigne {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ronges ce qu’ils aiment le plus. Tout être humain n’est qu’un souffle. Sélah
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} corriges les gens pour leur péché, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} détruis ce qu’ils aiment, comme une mite mange un tissu. Chaque personne est comme un souffle d’air. Sélah

sw.L: Kwa makaripio kwa ajili ya uovu unamwadibisha mtu, na kama nondo unaangamiza anachokipenda; hakika kila mwanadamu [ni] pumzi. Sela
sw.B: Unawaadhibu watu kwa makosa yao kwa makaripio, na kama nondo unakila kile wanachokipenda zaidi. Kila mwanadamu ni pumzi tu. Sela
sw.R: Unapowarekebisha watu kwa sababu ya dhambi yao, unaharibu kile wanachokipenda, kama nondo anavyokula nguo. Kila mtu ni kama pumzi ya hewa. Sela

es.L: Con reprensiones por la iniquidad {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} corriges a {{gender:la persona|el hombre}}, y como la polilla {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} consumes lo que más ama; ciertamente todo ser humano [es] un soplo. Selah
es.B: Tú castigas a la gente por sus faltas con reprensiones, y como una polilla {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} carcomes lo que más aman. Todo ser humano es solo un soplo. Selah
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} corriges a la gente por su pecado, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} destruyes lo que aman, como la polilla se come la ropa. Cada persona es como un soplo de aire. Selah

decisions.choice: like the moth: slow, quiet destruction
decisions.reason: The moth eats cloth little by little until it falls apart (Job 13:28; Isaiah 50:9).

decisions.choice: what he holds dear: beauty, wealth, all that is desired
decisions.reason: The word (chamud) is what is desired or treasured.

decisions.choice: a breath
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, the refrain returns.

decisions.choice: inclusive wording by default; the traditional "he" or "man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses a masculine singular for a person who stands for anyone of this kind, so the gender setting gives inclusive wording by default and the traditional form as the alternative.

decisions.choice: a person ... they
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is masculine but stands for anyone who lives this way. Balanced and Readable speak of people in general, which needs no setting; Literal keeps the singular with the gender setting.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: שִֽׁמְעָ֥ה־תְפִלָּתִ֨י׀יְהוָ֡ה וְשַׁוְעָתִ֨י׀הַאֲזִינָה֮ אֶֽל־דִּמְעָתִ֗י אַֽל־תֶּ֫חֱרַ֥שׁ כִּ֤י גֵ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י עִמָּ֑ךְ תּ֝וֹשָׁ֗ב כְּכָל־אֲבוֹתָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Hear my prayer, YHWH, and my cry for help give ear to; at my tears do not be silent, for a sojourner I [am] with you, a resident alien like all my fathers.

en.L: Hear my prayer, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and give ear to my cry for help; at my tears do not be silent, for I [am] a sojourner with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, a resident alien like all my fathers.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear what I pray; turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ear to my plea for help, and do not keep silent when I weep. I am only a guest with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, a foreigner passing through, just like my ancestors before me.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, listen to my prayer! Hear me when I cry for help. Do not ignore my tears. I am only staying with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for a short time, like a visitor, the way my ancestors were.

fr.L: Écoute ma prière, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et prête l’oreille à mon appel au secours ; devant mes larmes ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} tais pas, car je [suis] un immigré chez {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, un hôte de passage comme tous mes pères.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, entends ma prière ; tends l’oreille à mon appel au secours, et ne reste pas silencieux quand je pleure. Je ne suis qu’un hôte chez {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, un étranger de passage, comme mes ancêtres avant moi.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ma prière ! Entends-moi quand je crie au secours. Ne reste pas indifférent à mes larmes. Je suis seulement de passage chez {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour un peu de temps, comme un visiteur, comme l’étaient mes ancêtres.

sw.L: Usikie maombi yangu, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na utege sikio kwa kilio changu cha kuomba msaada; usinyamaze kwa machozi yangu, kwa maana mimi [ni] mgeni {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, msafiri kama baba zangu wote.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usikie ninachokuomba; utege sikio {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} kwa kilio changu cha msaada, wala usinyamaze ninapolia. Mimi ni mgeni tu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, mpitaji anayesafiri, kama walivyokuwa wazee wangu kabla yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sikiliza maombi yangu! Unisikie ninapolia kuomba msaada. Usiyapuuze machozi yangu. Ninakaa {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} kwa muda mfupi tu, kama mgeni, kama walivyokuwa wazee wangu.

es.L: Oye mi oración, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y presta oído a mi clamor; ante mis lágrimas no calles, porque forastero [soy] yo contigo, extranjero como todos mis padres.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, escucha lo que te pido; inclina {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} oído a mi grito de auxilio, y no te quedes callado cuando lloro. No soy más que un huésped contigo, un extranjero de paso, igual que mis antepasados.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡escucha mi oración! Óyeme cuando pido ayuda a gritos. No hagas caso omiso de mis lágrimas. Solo estoy contigo por poco tiempo, como un visitante, igual que mis antepasados.

decisions.choice: sojourner, resident alien: a guest on another's land
decisions.reason: A sojourner (ger) and a resident alien (toshav) lived on land that belonged to someone else, with no rights of their own. The land is the LORD's, and his people live on it as his guests (Leviticus 25:23; 1 Chronicles 29:15).

decisions.choice: do not be silent: do not refuse to answer
decisions.reason: God's silence is his not answering (Psalm 28:1).

decisions.choice: "un immigré … un hôte de passage" for ger and toshav at Literal
decisions.reason: Both words name someone living on land that belongs to another. The French terms for the Pentateuch use "l’étranger, l’immigré" for ger; toshav, the settler who stays a while, is "hôte de passage", which keeps the picture of a guest of God.

source.text: הָשַׁ֣ע מִמֶּ֣נִּי וְאַבְלִ֑יגָה בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֵלֵ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look away from me, that I may brighten up, before I go and am no more.

en.L: Look away from me, that I may brighten [again], before I go and am no more.
en.B: Turn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} gaze from me, and let me find joy again before I leave and am no longer here.
en.R: Stop looking at me in anger. Let me be happy again before I die and am gone.

fr.L: Détourne de moi [{{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} regard], que je retrouve le sourire, avant que je m’en aille et ne sois plus.
fr.B: Détourne de moi {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} regard, et laisse-moi retrouver la joie avant que je parte et que je ne sois plus là.
fr.R: Arrête de me regarder avec colère. Laisse-moi être heureux encore avant que je meure et que je disparaisse.

sw.L: Uniangalie mbali, nipate kuchangamka [tena], kabla sijaenda na kutokuwapo tena.
sw.B: Uyaondoe macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} juu yangu, niipate furaha tena kabla sijaondoka na kutokuwapo tena.
sw.R: Acha kunitazama kwa hasira. Uniache nifurahi tena kabla sijafa na kuondoka.

es.L: Aparta de mí la mirada, para que me alegre [de nuevo], antes que me vaya y no exista más.
es.B: Aparta de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mirada, y déjame volver a alegrarme antes de que me vaya y ya no esté aquí.
es.R: Deja de mirarme con enojo. Déjame ser feliz otra vez antes de que muera y ya no esté.

decisions.choice: look away: turn your searching gaze from me
decisions.reason: The verb (sha'ah, in this form) is to look away; the form may also come from a verb meaning to smear or shut the eyes (Isaiah 6:10). Either way the psalmist asks God to stop watching him in judgment (Job 7:19; 14:6).

decisions.choice: brighten: be cheerful, smile
decisions.reason: The verb (balag) is to brighten up (Job 9:27; 10:20).

decisions.choice: before I go and am no more: the psalm ends in the shadow of death
decisions.reason: Like Psalm 88, the psalm ends without a word of answer; the prayer itself is an act of trust.

decisions.choice: in anger
decisions.reason: Readable says what kind of looking the psalmist asks God to stop (m1).
